coldInstallBaseline.method: Disposable git worktree (`git worktree add --detach`) at executedAgainstCommit, outside the primary working tree, per the plan's disposable-checkout rule for cold installs. Ran the existing (pre-migration) command exactly as documented: `npm ci --foreground-scripts`, which triggers postinstall -> `lerna bootstrap` -> `lerna run compile`.
coldInstallBaseline.result: FAIL — application failure, not a prerequisite/infrastructure gap
coldInstallBaseline.diagnostic: test/integration/server.test.ts(1660,47) and (1726,47): TS2345 — an object literal passed to TssKeyGenModel.create(...) is missing the required `version` property on ITssKeyMessageObject.
coldInstallBaseline.rootCause: packages/bitcore-wallet-service/tsconfig.json includes `./test/**/*.ts` in the same compile the `build`/`compile` script runs (`tsc && npm run cp:templates`), so a type error in test code blocks the package's production build, not just its own test run.
coldInstallBaseline.provenance: git blame on the failing lines: commit 0c020e6ff4afc569af7800c5537dbf3e17c09b7c, message 'tests to demonstrate early short circuit bug (red at this commit)' — an intentionally-red test from unrelated, already-merged bug-fix work, present on both executedAgainstCommit and reviewedCommit (the wallet-service diff between those two commits is a separate, later 2-line addition, not this block).
coldInstallBaseline.classification: Unrelated pre-existing baseline defect. It is NOT caused by, and does not block, the Lerna-to-npm-workspaces migration itself — but it currently prevents a clean full `npm ci` / `lerna run compile` run on this exact commit/toolchain, and therefore also prevented lerna from ever attempting wallet-client, client, CLI, or node in that one aggregate run. Recorded per the plan's rule to log pre-existing defects separately with exact signature and unchanged reproduction; not in scope for this migration to fix.
coldInstallBaseline.followUpScope: Application/test-code fix in bitcore-wallet-service, outside this migration's task list.

resolution.change: Added `version: 1.1` to both TssKeyGenModel.create(...) fixtures in server.test.ts (the value already used by Defaults.TSS_KEYGEN_SCHEME_VERSION, Constants.TSS_KEYGEN_SCHEME_VERSION_MAX, and the sibling fixture in tss.test.ts).
resolution.verification: `rm -rf ts_build && npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run compile` both exit 0 for bitcore-wallet-service after the fix, rerun from a clean ts_build.
resolution.note: The author reports an independent PR carrying the identical fix is already out for review upstream; that PR is expected to reach parity with this branch by the time either is merged, so this defect is not expected to reappear once both land.

downstreamIsolationCheck.method: With lerna bootstrap's external-dependency install already complete (it finished before the compile stage failed), ran `npm run compile` individually inside each of the four packages lerna never reached, using the same disposable checkout.

results.note: precompile step ran `cd ../bitcore-node && npm run clean && npm run build:prod` (bitcore-node's tsconfig.prod.json, which excludes tests) before client's own build — reproduces the documented client/node build-order coupling from plan §81 and confirms it currently works when invoked standalone.
full `build` (tsc, unrestricted tsconfig.json) also succeeds standalone — no compile-blocking type error exists in node's own tree.

downstreamIsolationCheck.conclusion: The wallet-service test-type-check failure is the sole compile blocker among the seven compile-bearing packages on this commit/toolchain. Once it is fixed (or its tsconfig separates test type-checking from production build, as Task 1.3's design already prescribes for client), the documented 7-step compile order is expected to run clean end-to-end.

postFixEndToEndRun.method: After committing the version fix, ran the real `node node_modules/lerna/cli.js run compile --concurrency 1 --stream` in the primary working tree (not a disposable checkout — safe, since it only regenerates gitignored build output).
postFixEndToEndRun.firstAttempt: FAIL — bitcore-wallet-client's tsc reported TS2307, unable to find modules under ../bitcore-wallet-service/ts_build (test/tss.test.ts's import and wallet-service's own index.d.ts -> ./lib/storage), even though wallet-service's compile step had just reported success including cp:templates.
postFixEndToEndRun.secondAttempt: PASS — identical command, immediately rerun, completed all 7 packages successfully with no changes to any source.
postFixEndToEndRun.classification: Not confirmed as a reproducible defect: standalone reruns of wallet-service's own `npm run compile` and bare `npx tsc` always produced a complete ts_build (storage.d.ts and all lib subdirectories present); only the one lerna-orchestrated run showed an incomplete-looking ts_build immediately after wallet-service's step reported success, and a second identical lerna run did not reproduce it. Recorded as a single, non-reproducing anomaly worth a second look if it recurs (possibly a filesystem-flush race between lerna's child-process exit and its next spawn), not as a verified bug — do not build on it without reproducing it again.
postFixEndToEndRun.conclusion: With the version fix in place, the documented 7-step compile order (logging, crypto-wallet-core, wallet-service, wallet-client, client, CLI, node — lerna's own topological order differs slightly, e.g. it ran bitcore-client, whose precompile rebuilds bitcore-node, before wallet-service in both observed runs) completes cleanly end-to-end on this commit/toolchain.
